title: Pinecrest Customer Complaint Resolution
brief: A written resolution to a customer’s complaint about a damaged office chair and refund request, drafted from the case record and Pinecrest’s return policy.

slip.document:
# Pinecrest Customer Complaint Resolution
Customer case PC-260418 | 04/18/2026

## Case record
Customer: Nadia Rowland
Prepared by: Isabel Lindqvist, Customer Support Supervisor
Order PC-88421 was delivered on 04/12/2026. Nadia reported that the chair's left arm was cracked and requested a refund. The order record lists a chair charge of $24.50 and a delivery charge of $6.00. Pinecrest's damaged-item policy allows a refund of the chair charge and delivery charge when the customer provides the original receipt and the chair's serial number within 10 calendar days of delivery. The review confirmed that the report was received on 04/16/2026, within that period. Neil Coleman inspected the attached photographs and confirmed the damage is consistent with transit.

## Response to customer
Dear Ms. Rowland,

We reviewed your report and the photographs. The damage is consistent with transit, and your report was received within the policy's 10-day reporting period. We can approve a refund for the chair and delivery charge. The total refund is $36.50, returned to the original payment method.

To complete the refund, please email a copy of your original receipt to Pinecrest Service Desk. Once received, our team will verify the purchase and issue the refund within five business days. You do not need to return the damaged chair; please keep it until the refund is confirmed. We will send a confirmation email when the transaction is complete. If the original payment method is no longer available, contact the Service Desk before submitting the receipt so we can explain the available options.

Sincerely,
Isabel Lindqvist
Customer Support Supervisor
Pinecrest Service Desk
